name: logowright
description: Turn a logo PNG or JPEG into the clean, editable SVG vector a printer, sign maker or designer asks for.

interface.shortDescription: Logo PNG or JPG to clean SVG
interface.longDescription: logowright turns a logo saved as a PNG or JPEG into a clean, editable SVG vector: smooth curves, sharp corners and only the anchor points each shape needs. Use it when your logo exists only as a picture and someone needs the real file. That happens when you order shirts, uniforms, mugs, signs, van lettering or stickers and the shop cannot use your image, when a sponsor or an event asks for your logo in vector, when the logo came out of a logo maker or a chat as a PNG, or when the original file is lost. Shops and designers use it for the JPGs their customers send. Attach the logo, paste a link to it, or ask to convert a logo and drop it into the upload box that opens in the chat. You get a preview, the SVG, a version with each shape on its own layer (so a new colour or a white version is one step), and both as a zip. It works best on logos with 1 to 4 flat colours on a transparent or plain background, 400 px or larger. Text-only logos, gradients, photos, shadows and very small images are not converted, and the reason is given. logowright does not use an AI model to make your SVG, and it never uses your images to train one. Sign in with your logowright account to use it.
defaultPrompt: Convert my logo to a clean SVG.
My print shop asked for a vector of my logo. Convert this PNG to SVG.
Make this logo a vector I can recolour.

positive.description: Convert a logo through the upload box
positive.prompt: Convert my logo to a clean SVG.
positive.expected_behavior: convert_logo is called with no arguments and shows an upload box in the chat. After the sample logo is dropped into it, the box shows the SVG preview, 'Quality check passed', the anchor point count, whether a credit was used (1 the first time the account converts a picture, none for the same picture again), and the buttons Download SVG, Layered SVG and Both (.zip).

positive.prompt: Turn this logo into an editable SVG.
positive.expected_behavior: The attached PNG is passed as the image argument. The result shows the SVG preview with the download buttons, says the quality check passed and whether a credit was used (none for a picture the account already converted).

positive.description: Convert a logo from a link
positive.expected_behavior: convert_logo is called with image_url set to the link. The result shows the SVG preview with download buttons and links to the SVG, the layered SVG and the zip.

positive.prompt: How many logowright credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the number of credits left on the signed-in logowright account (the test account has 100). No plans, prices or links to buy are shown.

positive.description: An image that is not a flat logo is refused for free
positive.prompt: Convert this image to an SVG logo.
positive.expected_behavior: convert_logo refuses the gradient image with the reason (it has more colours than a flat logo; logowright takes logos with 1 to 4 flat colours) and the result says no credit was used.

negative.description: Designing a new logo is not what the app does: it converts an existing logo image, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Design a new logo for my bakery called Sunrise Bread.

negative.description: Converting a document is unrelated to logos, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Convert this PDF invoice into a Word document.

negative.description: Buying credits is not possible inside ChatGPT, so no purchase or plan is offered and no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 more logowright credits for me.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing logowright account; a successful conversion uses one of that account's credits. No plans, prices or purchase links are shown in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: convert a logo image (attached, linked or dropped into the upload box) into a clean, editable SVG, and check what is left on the account.
